method: Built-in image_gen tool; one generated illustration per icon

icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square icon for existing Chinese browser game. Q版、平面、手绘, cute chunky exaggerated inventory objects, warm brown hand-inked outlines, large simple silhouettes, restrained tan/ochre/sage/iron-grey colors, paper grain and only 1-2 flat shadow patches. Match reference inventory illustrations, not glossy fantasy concept art. Central objects fill 78% of square, cream parchment #fff8e7 backdrop with safe margins. NO people, NO humanoids, NO chicks, NO animals, NO faces, NO anthropomorphic objects, NO text, letters, numbers, borders, watermarks, 3D rendering, metallic shine, magical glow, gold filigree or complex FX. Scouting technology: a squat brass-and-dark-wood spyglass lies diagonally on a small partly unfolded parchment reconnaissance map. Map has just one hill, one path and a red location mark. Telescope, map only. Round simple hand-drawn objects. No eye or face symbols.
